summary: scripts/st-test lets one run at a time build and test in the kept build directory: two runs on different trees sharing it could test each other's binaries

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

compatibility.detail: Notes, commands and checks are unchanged. A second heavy st-test run on a host waits for the first instead of overlapping it.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; ST_EVIDENCE_TARGET=off also builds in the run's own worktree.
